name: Email Verification Retry Success
summary: An unverified durable user receives a verification code, enters an incorrect code once, then submits the correct current code and successfully verifies the email address.
finalOutcome: Email ownership is verified after a recoverable rejected attempt using the still-current verification proof.

sourceReferences.note: Representative retry behavior proves that a rejected attempt can remain on the same AuthView and later succeed without enumerating arbitrary retry combinations.
